logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the request

db:select.doc:description: Is there already a request with this key?
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = :idempotencyKey

choice.doc:description: A repeated key returns the first request without storing anything

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INFO - Repeated Idempotency-Key ' ++ vars.idempotencyKey ++ ': returning request ' ++ vars.requestId]

otherwise.doc:description: Validate and store the new request

flow-ref.name: requests-store-new-subflow

sub-flow.name: requests-store-new-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Checks the detail and the order, stores the request and its first history step, and publishes approval.requested

choice.doc:description: RESTOCK needs item, quantity, provider and the quoted price

when.expression: #[vars.newRequest.'type' == 'RESTOCK' and (vars.newRequest.detail.itemId == null or vars.newRequest.detail.quantity == null or vars.newRequest.detail.provider == null or vars.newRequest.detail.price == null)]

raise-error.description: RESTOCK needs detail.itemId, detail.quantity, detail.provider and detail.price

http:request.doc:description: The order must exist; its customer goes into the events

choice.doc:description: A request needs an existing order

set-variable.doc:description: Customer of the order (null when the CRM did not answer)

try.doc:description: Two requests with the same key at the same time: the second one returns the first
The request and its first history step together

db:insert.doc:description: Stores the request as PENDING with its expiry; the key is unique
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDER_REQUESTS (STATUS, EXPIRES_AT, ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, REQUEST_TYPE, ITEM_ID, PROVIDER_ABV, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMOUNT, CURRENCY, REQUESTED_BY) VALUES ('PENDING', SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '${requests.expiryHours}' HOUR, :id, :idempotencyKey, :orderId, :customerId, :requestType, :itemId, :provider, :qty, :unitPrice, :amount, :currency, :requestedBy)

db:insert.doc:description: First history step: PENDING, by the requester
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO ORDER_REQUEST_EVENTS (ID, REQUEST_ID, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, ACTOR, DETAIL) VALUES (:id, :requestId, :fromStatus, :toStatus, :actor, :detail)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { id: uuid(), requestId: vars.requestId, fromStatus: null, toStatus: 'PENDING', actor: vars.actor, detail: 'Requested' }]

on-error-continue.doc:description: The same key was stored by another request a moment ago

db:select.db:sql: SELECT ID FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = :idempotencyKey

sub-flow.name: publish-approval-requested-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: approval.requested for the approver; a broker failure is logged and the request stays stored

try.doc:description: The request is already stored: a failed announcement does not undo it

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'WARN - approval.requested not published for request ' ++ vars.requestId ++ ': ' ++ (error.description default '')]

flow.name: requests-list-flow
flow.doc:description: Requests in one status (or all), newest first, with their history

db:select.db:sql: #[output text/plain --- do { import requestColumns from modules::requests --- "SELECT " ++ requestColumns ++ " FROM ORDER_REQUESTS WHERE (:status IS NULL OR STATUS = :status) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID OFFSET :pageOffset ROWS FETCH NEXT :pageSize ROWS ONLY" }]

choice.doc:description: Without requests there is no history to read

db:select.doc:description: History of every request of the page
db:select.db:sql: #[output text/plain --- do { import eventColumns from modules::requests --- "SELECT " ++ eventColumns ++ " FROM ORDER_REQUEST_EVENTS WHERE INSTR(',' || :ids || ',', ',' || REQUEST_ID || ',') > 0" }]
db:select.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- do { import idList from modules::requests --- { ids: idList(vars.requestRows) } }]
